task_instance: Act as the AI Decision Authority skill: take a realistic list of 10 marketing/GTM workflows an agent might perform and classify each into Zone 1 (AI-Primary), Zone 2 (Collaborative) or Zone 3 (Human-Primary) using the skill's three questions (reversibility, exposure, frequency), produce both the single-decision output format and the list table, govern split workflows at the boundary, and name the misclassification cost.
evidence: This is a pure text-reasoning/classification skill requiring no code, binaries, credentials or network. Created sample input sample_workflows.md (10 marketing workflows). Produced the deliverable decision_authority_output.md applying the skill verbatim: two single-decision blocks in the skill's exact Decision/Reversibility/Exposure/Frequency/Zone/Rule/If-misclassified format (workflows 1 and 5), the Decision|Zone|Rule|Why table for all 10, a govern-at-the-boundary note splitting draft (Zone 1) from send (Zone 2/3) for the two mixed workflows (3 and 7), and a distribution check (7/10 in Zone 1). Verified by re-reading the skill's Workflow, Output format and Anti-Patterns sections and confirming every required output element is present, every zone rule matches, and the misclassification cost is named for each worked example as the skill requires. Files produced: sample_workflows.md and decision_authority_output.md in the work directory.
